description: Misconception variants and hard-negative controls for the C++ diagnostic bank. Each entry states the expected result of the verifier.

expect_values.fail_at_least_one: The variant compiles, and it fails at least one test case or it times out.
expect_values.compile_error: The compiler rejects the source. The verifier records the diagnostic.
expect_values.sanitizer_detected: AddressSanitizer reports a defect. The plain -O2 run is not reliable enough to assert.
expect_values.pass_all: Hard negative. The file is correct. It must pass every test case.

variants.note: Loop condition `i <= n` makes the exclusive upper bound inclusive.
Correct use of `<=` on a different range. A `<=` token alone is not evidence.
Prints the position of the largest value instead of the value.
Prints inside the function and returns 0. The return channel carries no value.
Reads index size() with `at()`. It throws std::out_of_range.
Loop condition `i <= size()` reads one element past the end. AddressSanitizer reports a heap-buffer-overflow.
Correct traversal that stops before index size(). The last line holds the last element.

variants.expected_warning: do not have their mathematical meaning
variants.note: Chained comparison `1 <= x <= 10` is always true. The compiler reports a -Wparentheses warning.
Correct range check written as a negated disjunction. It must not be flagged.
Condition `if (x = 0)` assigns. The compiler reports a -Wparentheses warning.

variants.expected_error: lvalue required as left operand of assignment
variants.note: Condition `if (0 = x)` assigns to a literal. The source is ill-formed.
Intentional assignment in a condition, with a comment. The taxonomy excludes this.
Recursive call passes n again. The stack is exhausted.
While loop never changes k. Small inputs reach the 2000 ms wall-clock limit.
While loop never updates i. It passes the index-0 test and times out on the absent target.
For loop has no update expression. Same behaviour as CP08__CPP-M08_a.cpp.
